description: Read the signed-in account’s UTC free-send allowance, prepaid balance in cents, reserved cents and last 20 charges. Lookups and availability stay free. Each agent identity gets 25 free sends per UTC calendar month; then a delivered message costs $0.25 and a confirmed booking $1.00, from prepaid Direct credit. Top up $10 or $50; nothing renews. Failed, refused and unconfirmed tasks cost nothing. Uses the same ledger as REST and your developer page. Requires direct:tasks. Changes nothing; phone minutes and legacy credits are separate.
name: get_direct_usage
title: Your Direct allowance and credits
